content: A plug retained during lift and transport can slip during insertion and then fall during retreat/fold. Preserve the successful prefix separately from the failed full task; do not assume a held object from an intermediate retreat frame.
applicability: Current right Piper; current cycle10/11 scene; yellow plug in original holder slot; RGB-only and gripper motor aperture, no six-axis force sensor
count_unit: Full real pick/insert attempt; one observed successful grasp/carry prefix is not a full task success
known_limits: One real attempt; no independent 3D pose or force measurement
Cannot isolate socket pose, contact geometry, grasp or friction as unique cause
18mm follow-up is simulation-only until a new real episode is evaluated
